title: Journal.
intro: Notes on designing and building the web at Ostrelya.

articles.title: How the Ostrelya loader became the navbar
articles.summary: The loading bar becomes the arrow in our mark, and the mark moves into the navigation. A short note on how we made the handoff.
articles.alt: Ostrelya’s metal mark with two rings and an arrow

sections.title: Start with the arrow
sections.text: The first piece you see is a horizontal bar. As it fills, its silhouette changes into the arrow from the Ostrelya mark. The rings and the wordmark appear around it.

sections.title: Give the mark somewhere to go
sections.text: The assembled mark moves from the centre of the screen to the navigation. The dark backdrop then contracts into the shape of the navbar, revealing the page around it.

sections.title: Make the navigation respond to reading
sections.text: The full navigation folds into the brand and contact action when you scroll down, then opens again when you scroll up. The home page also includes a reduced-motion version of the introduction.
